# remote-store

> Unified file-storage API for Python — one `Store` interface across Local,
> S3, S3+PyArrow, SFTP, Azure (Blob & ADLS Gen2), SQL, and Microsoft Graph
> (OneDrive/SharePoint). Write storage code once and switch backends by
> configuration; backends declare capabilities so code queries support with
> `store.supports(Capability.X)` instead of guessing.

Common patterns worth knowing up front: stream reads with
`with store.read(path) as f:`; use `MemoryBackend` for fast unit tests with no
real I/O; scope a store to a subtree with `store.child(prefix)`; reach extra
behaviour through `remote_store.ext` — content hashing (`ext.integrity`),
partitioned key layouts (`ext.partition`), and store-to-store copy
(`ext.transfer`). A native async API mirrors the sync one under
`remote_store.aio`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/tutorial/getting-started/): install, create a `Store`, and read/write across backends by config change alone.
- [Choosing a backend](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/guides/choosing-a-backend/): trade-offs across Local, S3, SFTP, Azure, SQL, and Graph.
- [Capabilities matrix](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/reference/capabilities-matrix/): which backend supports which capability.
- [API reference](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/reference/api/): `Store`, `Backend`, errors, and extensions.
- [Async API](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/guides/async/): `AsyncStore` and the sync/async bridge adapters.
- [Migration guide](https://docs.remotestore.dev/latest/reference/migration/): version-to-version upgrade notes.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/haalfi/remote-store): source, issues, and the authoritative docs.
- [FEATURES](https://github.com/haalfi/remote-store/blob/master/FEATURES.md): authoritative backend, extension, capability, and install-extras list.
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/remote-store/): releases and `pip install remote-store[...]` extras.
